summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing share repurchases under the third tranche of its 2026 buy-back programme, which runs from 23 July to 26 October 2026. Between 10 and 13 August 2026, Equinor purchased 597,632 own shares at an average price of NOK 384.37 per share, totalling NOK 229.7 million. Accumulated under the tranche, Equinor bought 2,207,004 shares at an average of NOK 381.72, spending NOK 842.4 million. Post-transactions, Equinor holds 16,462,779 own shares, or 0.69% of share capital, including shares under its savings programme. What to watch: continued execution of the announced buy-back tranche and potential impact on share count and EPS.
